newsitem.title: USA: PUMA running shoes sales up 400 pct in US.
newsitem.headline: PUMA running shoes sales up 400 pct in US.

text.p: PUMA AG Rudolf Dassler Sport said on Thursday that running shoes sales were up 400 percent in the United States for the year ending December 30, 1996.
The company also said its order book for 1997 running shoe sales were up more than 700 percent, compared with year ago levels.
PUMA cited the introduction of its "foamless" running shoe in January 1996 and its efforts to strengthen the brand's commitment to the U.S. running market.
